baseline.dependency_source: XW issue descriptions; only explicit hard dependencies are edges

global_invariants: Before an audited write cutover, the declared legacy path is the only state authority; shadow data is never a second authority.
A migration may use at most two consecutive formal release windows for dual-read or dual-write behavior.
Parity failure keeps or restores the legacy authority and blocks the next gate; no third temporary state path is allowed.
Every state change, external write, cutover, rollback, and destructive action records actor, reason, target, correlation id, gate decision, outcome, and timestamp.
LLM output may propose an action but cannot approve, execute, or mark a deterministic migration gate as passed.
No legacy route, table, index, fixture path, or compatibility branch is deleted before G7 and its item-specific P11 dependencies pass.

architecture_lanes.name: 产品与领域合同
architecture_lanes.completion_gate: P00.01-P00.06 accepted and the canonical roadmap DAG validates.

architecture_lanes.name: 存储安全与代码接缝
architecture_lanes.completion_gate: Retention, archive, projection, API/client seams, and focused regressions are reproducible.

architecture_lanes.name: Work Ledger
architecture_lanes.completion_gate: Work backfill and Issue compatibility parity pass; legacy Issue writes remain rollback-capable.

architecture_lanes.name: Run / Attempt Runtime
architecture_lanes.completion_gate: Run lifecycle, provider mapping, recovery, controls, and Sessions compatibility view pass.

architecture_lanes.name: Evidence 与 Verification
architecture_lanes.completion_gate: Structured Evidence and deterministic done policy pass success and rejection fixtures.

architecture_lanes.name: Handoff 与 Review
architecture_lanes.completion_gate: Local and remote delivery modes are audited, reversible where applicable, and reviewable.

architecture_lanes.name: Supervisor 与 Workflows
architecture_lanes.completion_gate: Supervisor uses domain tools and deterministic permission gates instead of direct state mutation.

architecture_lanes.name: Secrets 基线
architecture_lanes.completion_gate: Credential lifecycle and redaction contract are enforced before connector diagnostics expose state.

architecture_lanes.name: Automation、Attention 与 Approval
architecture_lanes.completion_gate: Automation claims are recoverable and all needs-user/external effects pass Attention/Approval gates.

architecture_lanes.name: Channels 与外部集成
architecture_lanes.completion_gate: Connectors preserve local authority, idempotency, provenance, permission, and outbox delivery audit.

architecture_lanes.name: Command Center 与产品 UI
architecture_lanes.completion_gate: Primary UI reads canonical projections and all compatibility entry points share the same domain commands.

architecture_lanes.name: 可靠性、安全、评测与部署
architecture_lanes.completion_gate: Backup/restore, restart, threat, evaluation, six Golden Journeys, capacity, onboarding, and release gates pass.

architecture_lanes.name: 兼容退出与 destructive 收口
architecture_lanes.completion_gate: G7 plus every item-specific zero-consumer, archive, backup/restore, rollback-window, and audit gate passes.

migration_gates.name: 合同基线
exit_evidence: Each stream names legacy authority, compatibility window, rollback, and delete gate
migration_gates.rollback_point: No runtime mutation; revert only the scoped plan artifacts.

migration_gates.name: 增量结构就绪
enter_when: The stream contract and field/state mapping are accepted
A current database copy and schema inventory exist
exit_evidence: Empty DB and upgrade-copy migrations pass
Only additive schema/index changes are present
Legacy reads and writes remain authoritative
migration_gates.rollback_point: Stop rollout and run the previous binary against the untouched legacy authority; unused additive structures may remain dormant.

migration_gates.name: Backfill 与 shadow 就绪
enter_when: Backup and restore rehearsal passed on the same source snapshot
Backfill has checkpoint and deterministic id mapping
exit_evidence: Count, state, relation, cursor, and sample parity report is clean
Shadow write/read failures do not alter the legacy result
migration_gates.rollback_point: Disable shadow path, clear only derived target rows using the recorded batch id, and continue legacy reads/writes.

migration_gates.name: 读切换
enter_when: W1 shadow comparison passed for one formal release window
A deterministic old-read fallback flag is tested
exit_evidence: Target read is primary in W2
API response and Golden Journey parity remain within declared tolerance
migration_gates.rollback_point: Flip the deterministic read flag to legacy and rebuild target projection from legacy authority.

migration_gates.name: 写切换与双模式退出
enter_when: Cutover actor and approval reference are recorded
All write callers converge on one domain command
exit_evidence: Target path is the sole write authority
Legacy API writes translate to the target command instead of writing legacy storage
Dual-read and dual-write are disabled by the end of W2
migration_gates.rollback_point: Before irreversible target-only data exists, stop target writes, restore legacy read/write flags, and replay the audited cutover delta into legacy authority.

migration_gates.name: 领域完成
enter_when: The stream has exited dual mode
exit_evidence: Affected Golden Journey success and failure branches pass from clean baseline
Observability exposes drift, fallback use, and blocked writes
migration_gates.rollback_point: Deploy the last compatibility build and use the stream rollback runbook; do not create a third path.

migration_gates.name: 兼容退出候选
enter_when: The target authority completed the declared rollback observation window
exit_evidence: Production route/module/table consumers are zero for one formal release window
Docs, fixtures, tests, and operator runbooks use the target path
Previous release artifact and data restore point are retained
migration_gates.rollback_point: Redeploy the retained compatibility build; restore archived data only through the rehearsed tool.

migration_gates.name: Destructive 删除授权
enter_when: All item-specific P11 dependencies are done
Fresh source backup and reviewed archive checksums exist
A non-LLM authorized actor approves the exact target and operation
exit_evidence: Destructive command report records before/after counts and checksums
DB integrity and affected Golden Journeys pass
Rollback limit and retained artifacts are documented
migration_gates.rollback_point: Code/routes roll back by the retained release artifact; dropped data restores only from the fresh backup/archive, never from model-generated reconstruction.

compatibility_policy.formal_release_window: One deployed binary/API/schema release observed under normal project workload and recorded with revision, start/end time, parity report, and consumer inventory.

windows.reads: legacy primary plus target shadow comparison
windows.writes: legacy primary plus optional idempotent target shadow

windows.authority: legacy until audited G4 cutover, then target
windows.reads: target primary with deterministic legacy comparison/fallback
windows.writes: single authority selected by the audited cutover flag
windows.purpose: read then write cutover; all dual modes end here

windows.writes: target only; legacy API adapters translate to target commands
windows.purpose: rollback observation without dual data paths

api.additive_period: Existing /api/issues, /api/sessions, and applicable /api/pi routes keep status and required-field semantics through G5; additions must be optional and unknown fields tolerated.
api.write_rule: A compatibility endpoint calls the same deterministic domain command as the target endpoint; it must not perform a second storage write.
api.removal_gate: G7 and the owning P11 issue; requires one formal release window of zero production consumers plus retained previous binary and API contract snapshot.
api.version_mismatch: Fail closed with an actionable compatibility error; never guess a schema/status mapping or let an LLM choose the winner.

migration_streams.source_of_truth_before_cutover: issues, issue_events, and current Issue API/state service
migration_streams.target_authority_after_cutover: works/work_relations/work_events and Work domain service defined by P02
migration_streams.rollback: Disable Work writes/reads, restore Issue flags, replay audited target-only delta by stable Issue-to-Work mapping, then rebuild Work projection.
migration_streams.final_delete_gate: P11.05/P11.09 after Issues consumer zero, backup/restore rehearsal, and G7.

migration_streams.source_of_truth_before_cutover: issue_runs; agent_sessions and provider sessions are observation/drill-down only
migration_streams.target_authority_after_cutover: issue_runs with the unified Run/Attempt relation and lifecycle defined by P03
migration_streams.rollback: Restore legacy lifecycle projection and Sessions view; retain new additive relation fields without treating agent_sessions as a second Run authority.
migration_streams.final_delete_gate: P11.05 only after Sessions consumers are zero and G7; issue_runs is retained unless a later migration ADR supersedes this plan.

migration_streams.source_of_truth_before_cutover: issue_events, issue_runs/provider facts, pi_action_events, Git, command outputs, and current verification payloads
migration_streams.target_authority_after_cutover: structured Evidence/Handoff records defined by P04/P05 while Git and external providers remain artifact authorities
migration_streams.rollback: Restore legacy evidence assembly, keep done gated by deterministic legacy verification, and rebuild structured records from provenance refs.
migration_streams.final_delete_gate: P11.03/P11.06 after every audit/provenance consumer maps to the target and G7.

migration_streams.source_of_truth_before_cutover: attention_inbox_items plus Guardian alert, approval request, project hold, and notification carriers with their current authorities
migration_streams.target_authority_after_cutover: unified Attention model; proposal/approval decision records remain deterministic permission authorities
migration_streams.rollback: Restore carrier-specific reads and routing, stop unified writes, preserve correlation/dedupe audit, and rebuild Attention projection.
migration_streams.final_delete_gate: P11.02/P11.03 only after unresolved items and permission audit parity are zero-drift and G7.

migration_streams.source_of_truth_before_cutover: pi_automations plus legacy cron_tasks/schedules, pi_delegations, heartbeat controls, and completion watches for their own IDs/cursors
migration_streams.target_authority_after_cutover: unified Automation definition/claim/run model from P08 with one owner for each trigger and cursor
migration_streams.rollback: Pause target scheduler, release/expire target leases, restore legacy scheduler flags and cursors from the cutover snapshot, then dedupe by idempotency key.
migration_streams.final_delete_gate: P11.04/P11.09 after no active claim/watch, cursor parity, restart rehearsal, archive, and G7.

migration_streams.source_of_truth_before_cutover: current Issue/Session/PI APIs and their existing UI entry points
migration_streams.target_authority_after_cutover: target domain APIs/projections; legacy routes are translation-only adapters during W3
migration_streams.rollback: Restore the previous route/UI feature flags or previous release artifact without changing the underlying single data authority.
migration_streams.final_delete_gate: P11.05 after zero-consumer telemetry for one release, contract snapshot, previous artifact retention, and G7.

exit_evidence: Previous binary compatibility or explicit fail-closed version gate

rollback_preconditions: Shadow feature flag disables all target writes
audit_preconditions: Record every shadow mismatch without mutating legacy result

data_migration_steps.name: checkpointed-backfill
rollback_preconditions: Batch ids allow derived rows to be cleared and rebuilt
audit_preconditions: Record batch actor, scope, counts, hashes, and errors

data_migration_steps.name: shadow-read-parity
audit_preconditions: Record comparison revision, window, sample, mismatch, and tolerance

data_migration_steps.name: read-cutover
rollback_preconditions: Deterministic read flag restores legacy path
audit_preconditions: Non-LLM actor, reason, approval ref, before/after flags

data_migration_steps.name: write-cutover-and-stop-dual-mode
exit_evidence: Compatibility writes translate to one domain command
Dual modes disabled by W2 end
Cutover delta and restart idempotency verified
backup_preconditions: Fresh pre-cutover backup and delta checkpoint
rollback_preconditions: Audited inverse mapping and replay procedure tested before target-only writes
audit_preconditions: Non-LLM actor, exact target, reason, approval ref, gate decision, outcome

data_migration_steps.name: rollback-observation-and-zero-consumer
exit_evidence: Golden Journeys and restart recovery pass
One release of zero legacy consumers
Previous artifact and restore point retained
backup_preconditions: Retain pre-cutover backup and current target backup
audit_preconditions: Record consumer inventory and fallback use

data_migration_steps.name: retire-legacy-api-and-compat-code
exit_evidence: Contract and Golden Journey tests pass
backup_preconditions: Legacy API contract and route inventory archived
Current source revision tagged by commit
rollback_preconditions: Previous release can be redeployed against the unchanged target authority
audit_preconditions: Non-LLM approval names exact routes/modules and zero-consumer evidence

data_migration_steps.name: drop-legacy-tables-and-indexes
exit_evidence: Drop migration passes empty and upgrade DBs
quick_check and affected Golden Journeys pass
Before/after size and row report recorded
backup_preconditions: Fresh SQLite online backup with SHA-256
Reviewable schema and row archive with parent-child mapping
rollback_preconditions: Restore command and target path are rehearsed
Rollback limit after new target writes is documented
audit_preconditions: Non-LLM approval names exact tables/indexes, reason, backup hash, archive hash, and maintenance window

data_migration_steps.name: remove-fixtures-placeholders-and-dead-code
exit_evidence: Production config and binary have no fixture/placeholder fallback
Relevant tests and binary smoke pass
backup_preconditions: Previous release artifact and source commit retained
rollback_preconditions: Previous release redeploy is compatible with the target authority
No deleted fixture data is required for live records
audit_preconditions: Non-LLM approval names exact modules/paths and live zero-reference evidence
